summary: Sandbach United's Joe Bevan has etched his name into the club's history books by becoming the Ramblers' all-time leading scorer with 56 goals, surpassing James Kirby's previous record of 54 in just two seasons. Fresh off a brace in their last match, the team will be looking to build on that form as they travel to Foley FC in search of back-to-back wins and a perfect start to the campaign.
